paper_title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks Integrating Compartmental Model for Analyzing COVID-19 Transmission Dynamics
evidence_summary: Section 3.1.1 of the primary paper states that the Italy data considered in the study are downloaded from Italian Civil Protection and the Ministry of Health and consist of cumulative infected, recovered and deceased cases for 20 February through 30 June 2020. This directly verifies the Civil Protection source relationship.
evidence_location: Section 3.1.1 Data; current official press area and historical COVID-19 press releases

paper_title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks Integrating Compartmental Model for Analyzing COVID-19 Transmission Dynamics
evidence_summary: The primary paper explicitly gives https://mn.gov/governor/covid-19/news/ after stating that events and interventions are available from official websites. The official resource is a Minnesota Governor COVID-19 news archive with 2020 intervention announcements. This verifies that the paper cites the resource, but the resource is geographically Minnesota-specific and does not validate the paper's adjacent Italy intervention-timeline claim.
evidence_location: Section 3.1.1 Data; Minnesota Governor COVID-19 News archive
